description: Provides flexible Dataverse connection string resolution for modern .NET, allowing applications to use a connection string directly or securely retrieve it from Azure Key Vault at runtime.

SAP OData, REST, Excel (okuma/yazma), veritabanı (ADO.NET, SqlBulkCopy), e-posta (SMTP/IMAP), loglama, güvenlik (AES-GCM, JWT, TOTP), serileştirme (CSV, sabit uzunluk, JSON, XML), dosya sistemi, tarih/tatil, metin ve koleksiyon servisleri içeren, birbirinden bağımsız ve yüksek performanslı .NET küt…
Pure C# in-process Small Language Model (SLM) runtime, GGUF v2/v3 binary parser, Paged KV-Cache allocator, Transformer decoder (RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA), and token sampling engine for .NET.

Azure Key Vault configuration provider for L33 apps. AddL33KeyVault() layers a Key Vault (from KeyVault:Uri) into IConfiguration using DefaultAzureCredential — the Azure Arc managed identity on servers, az CLI / Visual Studio / opt-in interactive browser in dev. No-op when KeyVault:Uri is absent.

Hy-MT2-1.8B-1.25Bit.gguf as embedded .NET resources (part 1/2). Installing this package pulls in all remaining parts; Sdcb.GgufWeights.Hy_MT2_1_8B_1_25Bit.Weights.Model() returns the stitched, seekable GGUF stream.
